parameters.query: SELECT r.email, r.candidate_name, COALESCE(j.title, 'Role') AS position, r.ai_score, r.skills AS key_skills, j.title AS job_title, r.interview_status FROM resume_data r LEFT JOIN job_descriptions j ON j.job_id = r.job_id WHERE r.email = $1 AND r.interview_status = 'SELECTED' ORDER BY r.email ASC LIMIT 1;

parameters.query: SELECT r.email, r.candidate_name, COALESCE(j.title, 'Role') AS position, r.ai_score, r.skills AS key_skills, j.title AS job_title, r.interview_status FROM resume_data r LEFT JOIN job_descriptions j ON j.job_id = r.job_id WHERE r.interview_status = 'SELECTED' ORDER BY r.email ASC;
